notes.title: New patch available!
notes.notes:
The new patch for Supercross 6 is out now! Enjoy improved AI performance on the realistic difficulty setting, fixed UI scoring in The Showman challenges, and more graphical improvements and fixes.

Read them down below!


 Improved AI’s performance on realistic difficulty setting.
 Fixed the point scoring UI in some The Showman challenges.
 Improvements on rider customization.
 Fixed graphical glitch on some official riders’ neck.
 Improved HDR tuning.
 Fixed graphical glitch on some official bikes front wheel.
 Fixed stickers positioning in livery editor.
 Fixed the replay cameras not working properly in Time Attack.
 Various fixes and improvements.

notes.title: New Patch Released!
notes.notes:
The latest patch of Supercross 6 has arrived, introducing Nvidia DLSS 2 support, lightning fixes on tracks, and other updates. Check for more in the link below!

https://supercrossthegame.com/new-patch-released-3/

notes.title: First update is out!
notes.notes:
Great news for you, riders: the first update for Supercross 6 is out!

Find new ways of having fun with the Rhythm Attack, now improved with the "Champions Raceway", the Tournament game mode and the Split Screen mode. But that's not all. Have a look at the full patch notes!

https://supercrossthegame.com/new-patch-released/
